name: manual_8e02c7
claim: A tool's provider config entry can be silently strict: when a client reports a misleading error (Cline 3.0.74 said invalid model ID), bisect the config one field at a time in an isolated config directory before blaming the model or the API. The 3.0.74 entry needs tokenSource manual (or the client's own oauth/migration) and an updatedAt like 2026-11-12T02:48:17.562Z (milliseconds, trailing Z).

decisions.notes: Verifiable steps, 2026-11-12: (1) direct API call with the same model and effort returned 200, so the provider was fine; (2) an identical command passed with one harness config and failed with another; (3) swapping tokenSource from a custom label to manual flipped fail to pass; (4) swapping updatedAt from +00:00 microseconds to millisecond Z flipped fail to pass; (5) the real switch script, once fixed and covered by tests, ran end to end into a throwaway HOME and a tool task passed. Old script written for 3.0.49 therefore could not drive 3.0.74.
